people.name: Amaziah
people.line: Priest of Bethel during Amos' ministry

people.name: Amos
people.line: Prophet from Tekoa who prophesied to Israel

translations.web: Amaziah also said to Amos, “You seer, go, flee away into the land of Judah, and there eat bread, and prophesy there:
translations.bsb: And Amaziah said to Amos, “Go away, you seer! Flee to the land of Judah; earn your bread there and do your prophesying there.
translations.kjv: Also Amaziah said unto Amos, O thou seer, go, flee thee away into the land of Judah, and there eat bread, and prophesy
translations.asv: Also Amaziah said unto Amos, O thou seer, go, flee thou away into the land of Judah, and there eat bread, and prophesy there:
